attributes.action: Hold a binding vote in Parliament to have a General Election if the PM changes
attributes.background: With Keir Starmer standing down and Labour looking for a new leader (who will become PM). We ask that Parliament hold a binding vote on an immediate General Election should a Labour Leader be elected who did not stand on the 2024 Labour manifesto.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
